mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in low-cost capital conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% triggers market concerns about inflation-driven monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.1% in one month signal robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and INDPRO both > 0.1% change in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS and INDPRO both increase > 0.1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in unemployment signals labor market recovery, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1.7 million units per month indicate sustained consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as broader economic activity expands.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1.7 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising housing starts (HOUST > 1.7 million) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates demand-supply mismatch, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1.7 million and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0%), a federal funds rate rise above 1.0% triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market repricing.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.
